raw_text: PMFBY is a government-backed crop insurance scheme that protects farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities such as drought, flood, cyclone, hailstorm, pests, and diseases. It covers prevented sowing, post-harvest losses for notified crops, and localized calamities. Premium payable by farmers is capped at 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial and horticultural crops, with the remaining actuarial premium heavily subsidized by the Central and State governments. Claims are triggered when actual yield in a notified area falls below the threshold yield and are aimed to be settled within about two months after yield data is finalized. Coverage, crops, and timelines vary by state.

what_it_does: Covers the structure and/or contents of a home against major natural and man-made risks.

coverage: Fire, lightning, explosion and implosion; Flood, inundation, storm, cyclone and other natural calamities; Earthquake damage to structure and contents; Burglary, housebreaking and attempted theft; Damage to household contents such as furniture, appliances and electronics; Optional cover for jewellery and valuables via add-ons (up to specified limits)
premium_example: ₹18/month for ₹5 lakh sum insured for a pucca building (illustrative only, not an actual quote).

premium_depends_on: Total sum insured (structure + contents); Type of dwelling (pucca / kachcha, flat / independent house); Location risk (flood/quake zone, crime rate, etc.); Security features (locks, alarms, gated community, etc.); Policy term (1 year to multi-year options); Optional covers selected (jewellery, terrorism, etc.)

structure_and_contents_details.structure_cover: Protects the building structure (walls, roof, floors, built-in fittings) usually on reinstatement value basis, for homes up to a certain age (e.g., 50 years).
structure_and_contents_details.contents_cover: Protects household contents (furniture, appliances, electronics, personal belongings) usually on market value basis after depreciation.
structure_and_contents_details.who_can_buy: Homeowners for structure + contents; Tenants for contents-only cover

what_it_does: Protects the residential building and its contents against major natural and man-made risks, with useful living-expense add-ons.

coverage: Loss or damage to building and contents due to fire, lightning and explosion; Damage due to flood, storm, cyclone and other specified natural disasters; Earthquake cover for structure and contents (if opted); Burglary, theft and housebreaking losses to contents; Electrical and mechanical breakdown cover for specified appliances (if selected); Coverage for reconstruction/repair of building and replacement of contents after covered events; Rent for alternative accommodation if the insured house becomes uninhabitable (as per chosen limit)

additional_features: Option to cover jewellery on worldwide basis (up to defined limits); Option to cover portable equipment like mobiles, laptops and cameras on all-risk basis; New-for-old replacement for contents up to a certain age (typically 10 years) in many variants; Auto restoration of loss limit for contents after a claim in some options; Optional covers like hotel stay, brokerage and shifting expenses when moving to alternate accommodation; Discounts based on security and long-term coverage options
who_can_buy: Homeowners for structure-only, contents-only, or combined structure + contents; Tenants for contents-only cover

what_it_does: Combines lifelong life cover with guaranteed yearly income after the premium paying term and a maturity benefit at age 100.

benefits.survival_benefit: Guaranteed annual survival benefit of 8% of the Basic Sum Assured every year after the premium paying term, payable till age 100 or death, whichever is earlier.[web:155][web:156][web:163]

benefits.maturity_benefit: At age 100, if the life assured survives, a lump sum equal to Sum Assured + vested simple reversionary bonus + final additional bonus (if any) is paid.[web:156][web:158][web:161][web:163]

benefits.death_benefit: If death occurs during the policy term (any time up to age 100), the nominee receives a lump sum death benefit (typically Sum Assured on Death + bonuses as per policy rules). Life cover is active from day one.[web:154][web:161][web:163]
benefits.loan_facility: Policy loans allowed after acquiring surrender value, giving liquidity while continuing cover.[web:161][web:163]
nature: Savings + protection plan (not a pure term plan) – premium per ₹1 lakh cover is higher compared to pure term insurance but provides income plus maturity value.[web:155][web:158][web:161]
key_parameters.coverage_upto_age: Coverage and benefits available up to 100 years of age of the life assured.[web:155][web:158][web:163]
key_parameters.premium_paying_terms: Common PPT options include 15, 20, 25 and 30 years; policy term is effectively 100 − entry age.[web:163]
key_parameters.entry_age: Minimum and maximum entry age are defined by LIC (check latest brochure/UIN for exact numbers).[web:154][web:161]
insurer_metrics_notes.claim_settlement_ratio_trend: LIC’s overall life claim settlement ratio has been around 98–99% over recent years (e.g., ~98.15% in FY 2024–25).[web:159][web:164][web:167]
insurer_metrics_notes.notes: LIC handles the highest volume of life claims in India and is widely seen as one of the most reliable life insurers.

best_for: People who want guaranteed long-term yearly income plus life cover up to 100 years; Conservative investors who value guarantees and LIC’s high claim settlement record over maximum-return or low-premium term-only solutions
what_it_does: Helps build a dedicated corpus for children’s higher education while ensuring that funding continues even if the parent (life assured) dies.
features.savings_component: Part of each premium goes towards building an education corpus that can be used for future school, college, or higher education costs.

features.life_cover_on_parent: Provides life insurance on the parent; on the parent’s death, the insurer may pay an immediate lump sum and/or continue future premiums (premium waiver) so that the child’s benefits are not disrupted.[web:160][web:162][web:165][web:168]
features.loan_protection: Can be structured to cover or support repayment of education loans in case the parent is no longer around.

features.flexible_payout_structure: Lump sum at key milestones such as start of higher secondary, undergraduate, or postgraduate education; Periodic payouts to meet tuition fees and living expenses across multiple years rather than only one big payout[web:160][web:162][web:165][web:168]
plan_nature: Investment-cum-insurance child education plan; may be endowment-style (guaranteed) or market-linked (ULIP-type), depending on product design.[web:162][web:165][web:168]

key_customisation_options: Choice of policy term to align with child’s age and target education years; Choice of premium payment mode (monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, yearly or single)[web:162][web:165]; Choice of payout pattern: lump sum at maturity, staggered payouts at milestones, or a combination[web:160][web:162][web:165][web:168]

best_for: Parents who want structured and disciplined savings for a child’s education plus protection if something happens to them; Families who prefer fixed, pre-planned payouts at school/UG/PG stages instead of ad-hoc investing
what_it_does: Protects a car against own damage and provides mandatory third-party liability cover.
